name: org.odk.collect.geo.geopoly.GeoPolyActivity
description: When a form asks the user to map a line or area, ODK Collect opens a map for placing points or recording a GPS path, then returns the shape to the form. It is part of the Samagra ODK Collect client.
disableEffect: Line and area mapping questions will no longer be answerable through the built-in map.
